parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
A random sample of 8 boxes of cereal from a certain supplier was taken. Each box was weighed and the masses in grams were as follows.

$$261 \qquad 249 \qquad 259 \qquad 252 \qquad 255 \qquad 256 \qquad 258 \qquad 254$$

Find unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The supplier claims that the mean mass of boxes of cereal is 253 g. A quality control officer suspects that the mean mass is actually more than 253 g. In order to test this claim, he weighs a random sample of 100 boxes of cereal and finds that the total mass is $25\,360$ g.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Given that the population standard deviation of the masses is 3.5 g, test at the 5% significance level whether the population mean mass is more than 253 g.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.stem: An employee says, ‘This test is invalid because it uses the normal distribution, but we do not know whether the masses of the boxes are normally distributed.’
parts.text: Explain briefly whether this statement is true or not.
